_comment: The practice sources in force in this repository, per Precedent's
three-source model (alex137/BestPractice, branch precedent-beta-v01,
PRACTICE_ENGINE_PLAN.md, 'Source -- Who a Practice Belongs To').
A shared repository declares universal and team sources ONLY -- a
person's individual set goes in their own user-level config
(~/.config/precedent/config.json, or PRECEDENT_USER_CONFIG), never
here, so naming it here cannot leak its existence to everyone with
read access to this repo. See tools/precedent_resolve.py (vendored at
process/upstream/tools/) for the resolution and precedence rules, and
process/PRECEDENT_MIGRATION.md for how this repo got here (2026-09-02,
beta test) and what does and doesn't work yet.
'universal' points at process/upstream/, this repo's existing vendored
copy of BestPractice (INSTALL.md Sec.1) -- unlike a fresh Precedent
install, universal is NOT resolved from a live sibling clone here,
because a vendored copy is what makes this repo's practice set work
offline and for collaborators without that sibling checked out.
'team' points at a sibling clone of precedent-team-maintainers,
Morgan and Alex's real team practice set (the same live-sibling-clone
pattern Precedent uses for its own precedent.json) -- it replaces the
old process/personal/ vendored copy of RepoPersonalPreferences,
retired in the same change that added this file.
